purpose: Record explicit user approvals and notes on model suggestions, not executed results.

user_consent.approved_source: Explicit user approvals in this conversation: 60-case plan, addition of Muse generator, Muse product-improvement condition, ordinary OpenRouter balance without BYOK
user_consent.approved_scope: 60 unique development cases, two repetitions, eight pairs; no full pilots; $5 direct API, 300 subscription conservative attempt units, 600 total attempt units

execution.local_preparation_status: implemented local preparation is waiting for this document and requires verification before paid work

limits.opencode_quota_note: OpenCode internal retries are five retries after the initial attempt: six permanent quota units per prompt.

phases.smoke: First six frozen cases, repetition 1; no extra cases.
phases.first_pass: Complete all first-pass requests for both repetitions before any repair.
phases.repair_and_recheck: At most one branch repair and one recheck after first-pass coverage.
phases.batch_rationale: Chosen to fit quota, not to make random model changes.

muse.model_generation_note: Muse is treated as a cheap fourth-generation suggestion, not an independent annotator.

muse_consent.condition: User consent covers possible product improvement.
muse_consent.training_claim: Do not claim confirmed training on every prompt.
muse_consent.source_file_policy: Text context only; no keys or code.
muse_consent.ordinary_openrouter_balance: User confirmed ordinary balance without BYOK.
muse_consent.subtitle_excerpts: User may transfer subtitle excerpts under provider terms and has consented to that possibility.

selection.source: Seven test files, excluding pilot raw and canonical files and S44E11.
selection.rank: SHA-256 of sh08-matrix-v1:20260914:<case_id>, sorted by digest and case_id.

accounting.monetary_reservation: Reserve full context plus max output multiplied by 1.10, compared with actual cost reported by OpenRouter and conservative no-cache DeepSeek cost.
accounting.subscription_counting: Count logical prompts against the six-attempt upper bound; do not claim exact physical visibility.
accounting.coverage_reporting: Primary first-pass coverage is separate from repairs, which may be budget-limited.
accounting.gemini_flex_note: Chosen sync Flex price is the same as the listed batch price; no day wait is required.
